About The Project Office Gazanche Primary School is located in Gurage Zone, Central Ethiopia Region, about 28 km south of Wolkite Town, serving three rural kebeles with an estimated population of around 10,000 people. Established in 2010 through community efforts, the school currently accommodates about 1,000 primary students (Grades 1–8) and 50 nursery children. However, the existing infrastructure is inadequate and below national standards, consisting mainly of traditional wooden-mud classroom blocks with only nine classrooms, resulting in severe overcrowding with up to 80 students per classroom. The school also lacks basic facilities such as an administration building, library, reliable sanitation, electricity, water supply, and secure fencing. Planned works include the construction of new classrooms, administration and library buildings, gender-separated sanitation facilities, fencing, walkways, drainage systems, landscaping, and solar power installations. These interventions aim to reduce overcrowding, improve safety and sanitation, and expand access to quality education, particularly for girls, children with disabilities, and underserved rural communities, in line with SDG 4 (Quality Education) and Ethiopia’s Education Sector Development Programme VI. title: Donor Assistant (South West)
description: Home About us Our people Join our team Donor Assistant (South West) Donor Assistant (South West) Part time (Minimum of 12 sessions a year) | Saturdays and Sundays| £13.45/hour Gloucester, Bristol, Cardiff, Wellington, Wells The Role Award-winning animal charity, Pet Blood Bank UK, is recruiting for a Donor Assistant to work at venues across the South-West. As part of the collection team, this role involves working at donation sessions where lifesaving blood is collected from dogs. As a Donor Assistant, you are responsible for helping to run the session, including holding our donors while they give blood, tidying and resetting the donation room for the next donor, running blood tests, assisting with paperwork and the potential to meet up to 23 potential donors and their owners at each session. The role is key to ensuring successful donation sessions and providing a positive experience for all our donors and their owners. We are looking for a Donor Assistant to cover Gloucester, Bristol, Cardiff, Wellington and Wells; however, a willingness to travel is essential as there may be times you are asked to work across the entire region. Background Launched in 2007, Pet Blood Bank UK is the only charity that provides a blood bank service for all vets across the UK. As part of our charitable remit, our aim is to advance animal health and welfare and to relieve suffering by providing quick and convenient access to blood. Every unit of blood helps save up to four other lives, saving thousands of lives every year. Our values Caring. Pioneering. Real. These are the values Pet Blood Bank UK is built upon. Our values bind us together as a charity and guide everything we do. We expect every team member to know, understand and embody our values, helping to build our reputation as a pioneering, caring and practical charity. Read more about our values. What you’ll do Assist the Veterinary Surgeon and Veterinary Nurse with all donors to ensure health check, donation and post donation tasks are carried out. Assist with paperwork and running blood tests. Help to hold our donors during the donation process. Assist with monitoring donors throughout the donation process. Build a rapport with donors and their owners to ensure they feel valued and involved - provide a positive donation experience from start to finish. Maintain a good relationship with our host venues. Communicate with Pet Blood Bank staff, including your regional collection team, Regional Coordinator, Area Supervisor and office staff. Attend events to promote Pet Blood Bank and recruit donors and volunteers What we need We’re Looking For Someone Who Is An excellent communicator with strong customer care skills. A team player. Experienced in animal care, ideally with a qualification but not essential, and have a love of working with dogs. This is an ideal role for a student/newly qualified veterinary nurse/student vet/person with animal experience. Organised and proactive. Availability on Saturdays and Sundays Holds a full UK driving licence and has access to their own transport. To ensure you can complete the required training we may arrange for you to attend some sessions outside of the region, mileage allowance and accommodation will be organised where required. What’s in it for you In return, we offer full training and a great team working environment. The rate of pay is £13.45/hour and a mileage allowance of 35p/mile offered for travel to and from venues. Further details Sessions are approximately 8 hours in length and flexibility is essential as start and finish times will be dependent upon the travel time to and from the venues. Donor Assistants are expected to work at least one session per month to meet the required expectation of a minimum of 12 sessions a year to maintain their skills, but additional sessions may be available. Own transport is required to get to venues - please note not all venues are accessible by public transport. Before applying, please read our Guidance for Candidates. For more information or to request a full job description, please email recruitment@petbloodbankuk.org. To apply, please complete our application form and email it to recruitment@petbloodbankuk.org.

title: Country Manager
description: 【岗位背景】 星星充电作为全球大型智能充电设备供应商及微电网系统先驱，已于2026年初开启IPO进程。根据公司全球化战略，我们正全力拓展非洲、中东、东南亚等高增长市场。本岗位将作为公司在非洲目标国家的“一 把手”，负责从0到1搭建本地业务体系，推动充电桩、微电网、户用及工商业储能、光伏安装项目的规模化落地。 【岗位职责】 1. 战略制定与业务落地 市场洞察与战略规划： 根据非洲目标国家（摩洛哥、南非、尼日利亚、卢旺达）的市场特点，制定中短期业务战略。重点结合当地脆弱的电网现状及“Mission 300”等国际能源接入计划，识别高价值落地场景。 业绩指标负责： 对目标国家的销售与营收目标负责，重点突破“光储柴”微电网、矿区离网储能、工商业“储能+充电”一体化项目。 2. 市场开发与生态构建 客户与渠道拓展： 挖掘高耗能矿企、大型工商业园区、电信基站及当地能源投资商等核心客户；发展与当地工程施工商（EPC）的长期伙伴关系，监管项目履约质量。 政府与金融关系： 维护与当地能源部、电力监管局、投资促进署的关系，确保项目合规；对接国际金融机构（如世界银行、非洲开发银行）及本地银行，探索适合非洲市场的融资解决方案（如PPA模式、租赁模式）。 3. 解决方案与交付协同 商务技术支持： 深入掌握微电网及储能商业模式，根据客户需求（如降低柴油成本、保障不间断供电）提供高性价比的技术与商务方案。 项目交付保障： 与技术及工程团队紧密协作，确保项目顺利并网、交付及后期运维保障。 4. 品牌建设与市场分析 品牌占位： 代表公司参与当地行业协会（如AMDA）、能源峰会及展会（如摩洛哥EVS展），提升星星充电在当地的品牌声誉。 竞品监控： 持续调研当地政策法规、电网标准及竞争对手动态（如法国EDF、本地集成商），定期输出市场分析报告。 5. 团队搭建与管理 本土化团队建设： 负责本地核心团队的组建、培养与日常管理，打造一支具备战斗力的“中方+本地”混血团队，传承公司文化。 【任职资格】 学历经验： 本科及以上学历，电气工程、电力系统、能源经济等相关专业优先。5年以上新能源（储能、光伏、微电网）项目开发与落地经验，具备中资企业驻外经历者优先。 属地化知识： 深刻理解非洲目标国家的投资环境、劳工法、税务政策及电力行业准入规则，能够处理复杂的清关、运输及签证问题。 专业能力： 具备扎实的电力系统知识，能向客户清晰讲解“光储充”一体化及微电网技术原理与商业价值。 商业与金融思维： 具备优秀的财务分析能力，能够独立测算项目IRR，并利用金融工具（如PPA、融资租赁）解决非洲市场支付能力痛点。 语言与软技能： 精通英语或法语（视国家而定），可作为工作语言进行技术与商务谈判。 具备极强的抗压能力、商业敏锐度及跨文化沟通能力。 地点： 接受长期在非洲工作（每年至少10个月以上常驻）。 【加分项】 拥有当地政府、大型矿业集团或电力公司高层人脉资源。 熟悉华为、阳光电源、德业、固德威等同行的非洲业务运作模式。 具备从0到1的办事处/分公司筹建经验。

title: Veterinary Surgeon (South West)
description: Home About us Our people Join our team Veterinary Surgeon (South West) Veterinary Surgeon (South West) Part time (Minimum of 8 - 12 sessions a year) | Saturdays and Sundays| £29.57/hour The role We are recruiting for a Veterinary Surgeon to work at venues across the South-West. As part of the collection team, this role involves working at donation sessions where lifesaving blood is collected from dogs. You will ensure all donations are performed in line with our standard operating procedures, maintaining high welfare standards whilst working alongside Veterinary Nurses and Donor Assistants. There is the potential to meet up to 23 donors and their owners at each session. The role is key to ensuring successful donation sessions and providing a positive experience for all our donors and their owners. We are looking for 1 Veterinary Surgeon to cover Gloucester, Bristol, Cardiff, Wellington, Wells and 1 Veterinary Surgeon to cover High Wycombe, Godalming, Alton, Winchester, Chichester; however, a willingness to travel is essential as there may be times you are asked to work across the entire region. Background Launched in 2007, Pet Blood Bank UK is the only charity that provides a blood bank service for all vets across the UK. As part of our charitable remit, our aim is to advance animal health and welfare and to relieve suffering by providing quick and convenient access to blood. Every unit of blood helps save up to four other lives, saving thousands of lives every year. Our values Caring. Pioneering. Real. These are the values Pet Blood Bank UK is built upon. Our values bind us together as a charity and guide everything we do. We expect every team member to know, understand and embody our values, helping to build our reputation as a pioneering, caring and practical charity. Read more about our values. What you’ll do Overall supervision of blood donation sessions, the collection team, and volunteers Physical examination of blood donors Ensure owners of donors are fully aware of the blood donation procedure Perform donor blood sample collection Ensure donor records are completed correctly and in full Ensure a positive experience for the donor and owner from start to finish Assist with and support the training of new team members and ensure all training records are complete Opportunity to attend events to promote Pet Blood Bank and recruit donors What we need We’re Looking For Someone Who Is Qualified MRCVS with current RCVS registration Minimum 1 year post-graduation small animal clinical experience An excellent communicator with strong customer care skills Confident working in a small team and with the ability to lead/direct those working with you. Holds a full UK driving licence and has access to their own transport. Is organised, pro-active and team orientated. Has the ability to problem solve, has good organisation skills and attention to detail. Is confident in blood sampling with owners present. Availability on Saturdays and Sundays To ensure you can complete the required training we may arrange for you to attend some sessions outside of the region, mileage allowance and accommodation will be organised where required. What’s in it for you In return, we offer full training and a great team working environment. The rate of pay is £29.57/hour, VDS cover provided and mileage allowance of 35p/mile offered for travel to and from venues. Further details Sessions are approximately 8 hours in length and flexibility is essential as start and finish times will be dependent upon the location of the venue. Pet Blood Bank envisage that you will work approximately 1 session a month, however there may be the option to work more. Own transport is required to get to venues - please note not all are accessible by public transport. Before applying, please read our Guidance for Candidates. For more information and a copy of the job description, or to apply, please complete our application form and email it to recruitment@petbloodbankuk.org.

title: Programme Officer (Return and Reintegration) (P)
description: Job Description Introduction Established in 1951, IOM is a Related Organization of the United Nations and the leading UN agency in the field of migration. Working closely with governmental, intergovernmental, and non-governmental partners, IOM promotes humane and orderly migration for the benefit of all. It saves lives and protects people on the move, drives solutions to displacement, and facilitates pathways for regular migration, while providing services and advice to governments and migrants. IOM is committed to fostering a respectful, inclusive, and supportive workplace where all employees can thrive professionally and feel valued. By creating such an environment, IOM aims to better harness the full potential of migration and strengthen its support to people on the move. IOM invites candidates from diverse backgrounds to apply and provides reasonable accommodation throughout the recruitment process when required. Learn more about IOM’s workplace culture at IOM workplace culture | International Organization for Migration . Applications are welcome from first- and second-tier candidates, particularly qualified female candidates, as well as applications from the non-represented member countries of IOM. For all IOM vacancies, applications from qualified and eligible first-tier candidates are considered before those of qualified and eligible second-tier candidates in the selection process. For the purpose of this vacancy, the following are considered first-tier candidates: Internal candidates Candidates from the following IOM Member States that are not represented among staff members in the Professional and higher categories: Bahamas, Barbados, Comoros, Congo (the), Cook Islands, Dominica, Federated States of Micronesia, Grenada, Guinea-Bissau, Holy See, Iceland, Israel, Kiribati, Marshall Islands, Namibia, Nauru, Palau, Saint Kitts and Nevis, Saint Lucia, Samoa, Sao Tome and Principe, Seychelles, Solomon Islands, Suriname, Timor-Leste, Tonga, Tuvalu, Vanuatu Second-tier Candidates Include All external candidates, except candidates from non-represented member states of IOM. Context IOM's Protection Unit aims to contribute to promoting and upholding the rights of migrants, including displaced persons and their communities, reducing protection risks, and supporting Governments to manage migration by implementing preventive, responsive, remedial, and standard-setting actions. These actions are implemented through the 6 Protection operational pillars – thematic guidance, direct assistance, convening and dialogue, advocacy and communication, training and capacity building, and data, research and learning, while adhering to the division's core commitments of protection mainstreaming, accountability and inclusion, sustainability and systemic change, and partnership and coordination. The Protection Unit oversees development of policy and technical guidance in these areas, provides programmatic support to IOM missions, and implements protection and assistance programmes of global relevance. Under the overall supervision of the Head of Programmes in Ethiopia and direct supervision of Senior Programme Officer (Protection), and in close coordination with the Regional Thematic Specialist (RTS) at the Regional Office (RO) for East and Horn of Africa in Nairobi and relevant Divisions/Departments/Units at Headquarters (HQ), the Programme Officer (Return and Reintegration) will be responsible for managing, coordinating and overseeing the activities under the Migrant Return and Reintegration Portfolio in Ethiopia. Responsibilities Oversee the effective development and implementation of the Migrant Return and Reintegration Programme, backstopping the administrative, operational, and financial aspects for relevant projects. Provide operational management, guidance, and technical supervision to the Migrant Return and Reintegration Programme national and international staff, assisting with programmatic strategy and implementation, including where to focus programme resources and address operational challenges as they arise. Establish, maintain, and further expand strong relationships across UN Agencies, humanitarian organizations, government and community interlocutors, and with a broad range of other local interests toward the successful implementation of the Migrant Return and Reintegration Programme. Identify the priorities arising during the implementation of the Programme and contribute to the development of the new projects and activities under the Programme. Identify upcoming opportunities and programme focus areas arising from Return and Reintegration activities within the Programme. Contribute to the development of new projects and activities within the Programme, aligning them with the identified priorities, emerging trends, donor interests, and operational requirements, in close coordination with the Senior Programme Officer, Head of Programme, relevant Regional Offices, relevant Units at HQ, as well as with Government

We’re looking for someone who enjoys keeping things organized, spotting issues before they become problems, and making sure every detail on a Shopify store is working as it should. If you take pride in clean product listings, accurate inventory, and a well-maintained storefront, this role is for you. What You’ll Own Maintaining and optimizing Shopify product listings for clarity, accuracy, and conversion Regularly auditing the website to identify errors, inconsistencies, or outdated content Monitoring inventory levels and helping prevent stock gaps or overselling Responding to customer reviews to support brand trust and engagement Updating website visuals such as banners, landing pages, and product images Coordinating with vendors on inventory, purchase orders, and order tracking What Sets You Apart At least 1 year of hands-on experience in e-commerce or Shopify management Comfortable navigating Shopify and related tools independently Strong attention to detail and ability to keep things organized across multiple tasks Clear written communication, especially when handling customer-facing content Proactive mindset with the ability to work efficiently in a remote setup Technical Requirements Reliable internet connection with at least 25 Mbps upload and download speed Personally owned PC or laptop with at least an i5 processor or equivalent What You’ll Get Permanent remote work setup Paid time off Health and dental coverage Performance recognition and growth opportunities A collaborative team that values reliability and initiative At TalentPop App, the work you do directly supports the success of growing e-commerce brands. If you already have experience and want to build on it in a role where your attention to detail makes a real difference, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now and take the next step in your e-commerce career.

title: Affiliate Marketing Coordinator
description: At TalentPop , we're helping e-commerce brands scale with world-class talent and exceptional customer experiences. As we continue to grow, we're looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Affiliate Marketing Coordinator to join our team. In this role, you'll help manage and expand TalentPop's affiliate marketing initiatives through outreach, relationship building, campaign coordination, and performance tracking. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys building partnerships, analyzing results, and contributing to the growth of a fast-paced remote company. What You'll Do Support the setup, management, and optimization of affiliate marketing programs Identify and recruit potential affiliates that align with client brands and goals Manage day-to-day communication with affiliates, ensuring strong relationships Coordinate affiliate promotions, campaigns, and special offers Track, analyze, and report on affiliate performance metrics Prepare regular performance summaries for account managers and clients Assist with payout processes and ensure accuracy in affiliate tracking systems Research competitor affiliate strategies and recommend improvements What We're Looking For At least 1 year of online/remote work experience (required) Experience with affiliate marketing, partnerships, or influencer programs preferred Proficiency in Google Workspace and Microsoft Excel/Sheets Strong communication and relationship management skills Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple campaigns Bonus points if you have experience with affiliate platforms (ShareASale, Impact, CJ Affiliate, etc.) Technical Requirements A laptop or desktop with at least an i5 processor (or Mac equivalent) A reliable internet connection with at least 25 Mbps download/upload speed A quiet, dedicated workspace What We Offer 100% remote work — work from anywhere Performance reviews and growth opportunities within our team Paid time off to support your work-life balance Access to learning tools and regular feedback to fuel your career development A collaborative and supportive work environment where your contributions truly matter Important: To be considered for this position, please make sure to include the following application code in your submission: AFF26 . This code helps us quickly identify applicants for the Affiliate Marketing Coordinator role. Applications submitted without this code may experience delays in processing. Be sure to highlight it clearly when you apply so our recruitment team knows you’ve carefully read the job posting. If you’re an experienced online professional who’s ready to help high-growth brands expand their reach through affiliate marketing — we’d love to meet you. Apply now and join a team that values your skills, drive, and ambition!
